name: Ur'Epona
specialQualities: low-light vision
plane shift (Sp -- 1/day, transports itself and its rider to a plane of the rider's choice; an unwilling rider may resist with a DC 17 Will save; caster level 9th)
scent
appearance: A large, horselike creature with a hide that bears no fixed color, shifting instead between glistening white and deep sable as its mood changes. Its build is powerful and equine, marking it as a distant descendant of a horse-goddess.
behavior: An ur'Epona avoids combat when it can, though it will fight to protect itself and its offspring if pressed. It cannot speak, but understands any language spoken to it, and can be trained over weeks of patient work to bear a rider or carry them between planes.
appearanceGreenbound: The ur'Epona's shifting hide has thickened into pulpy, bark-like wood, its color-changing sheen replaced by mottled patches of lichen and moss that darken and pale in the same restless way its coat once did. Slender green vines trail from its mane and fetlocks like living tack, and small budding twigs push out along its withers and flanks, though its equine silhouette and powerful gait are unmistakably preserved.
note: Its hoof attack is explicitly written as secondary (half Str to damage) even though it's the creature's only natural weapon -- an exception to the usual single-natural-weapon 1.5x rule.

name: Air Elementite Swarm
specialAttacks: air mastery (Ex -- airborne creatures take -1 on attack and damage rolls against it)

distraction (Ex -- a living creature the swarm can damage that starts its turn in the swarm's square is nauseated for 1 round unless it makes a DC 13 Fortitude save; casting or concentrating in the swarm needs a Concentration check, DC 20 + spell level; patient skills need a DC 20 Concentration check)
trip (Ex -- free action, no touch attack or attack of opportunity, +4 check modifier, treated as Large; a failed attempt cannot be turned back on it)
specialQualities: darkvision 60 ft.
elemental traits (immune to poison, sleep, paralysis, stunning; no critical hits or flanking damage; cannot be raised or resurrected)

swarm traits (no critical-hit or flanking damage; never staggered or dying, breaks up at 0 hp; cannot be tripped, grappled or bull rushed and cannot grapple; immune to single-target effects; takes +50% damage from area effects)
appearance: A faint, cloud-like shimmer drifting through the air. Up close, countless tiny air elementals can be picked out within it.
behavior: Swarms wander the Plane of Air like restless clouds, sometimes grouping until the air is thick with them. They hunt down and harass anything that isn't an air elemental.
note: Summoned by Summon Elementite Swarm (Planar Handbook p.105, Drd 4), not by summon nature's ally. Occupies a 10-ft. space with 0 reach but can squeeze into any four contiguous 5-ft. squares and through any gap a Tiny creature fits. Never makes attacks of opportunity. Fly is perfect maneuverability.

appearance: The ground buckles as if from a small local tremor. The swarm is a crowded mass of cat-sized rocks.
behavior: They delight in crushing, rolling over terrain and creatures and grinding anything in the way to rubble.
note: Summoned by Summon Elementite Swarm (Planar Handbook p.105, Drd 4), not by summon nature's ally. Printed Initiative +3 and Ref +8 don't fit the printed Dex 8 (Dex -1 would give Init -1, Ref +4) and Fort +2 doesn't include the Con bonus; the book entry looks misprinted. Toughness is taken three times (9 bonus hp).
